about: The hybrid terminal, second camera: one frame of the clip beside the truck, frozen; the crane lifts the container off the wagon and sets it down on the truck's rear trailer.
setup: for (const n of [1, 7, 8, 9]) { const c = term._wagonCarrier(n); if (c.pose) Object.assign(c, { present: true, available: true, tracked: 'standing' }); } for (const c of term.markerWagons()) if (!c.present) c.pose = null; app.world.events.emit('terminal.request.move', { container: 'TUDU 600002 9', to: { carrier: 'W1', bay: 1 } });
